executive_summary: Delancer V1 exhibits critical due-diligence red flags including token launch and presale scheduled prior to smart contract audits, completely anonymous leadership with no verifiable credentials, and reflection tokenomics promising passive returns that present severe regulatory securities liabilities. Furthermore, the 3% transaction tax on every transfer directly contradicts the stated goal of minimal fees for freelancers, while essential technical mechanisms (escrow, dispute resolution, and payment card compliance) are entirely absent.

top_risks.description: Explicit promises of passive yield ('generate good income, all they need to do is hold and earn') from transaction taxes strongly fail the Howey Test, exposing the project to immediate regulatory and unregistered securities enforcement.
Smart contract audit is scheduled for Q2 2023, while the Pre-Sale, Token Launch, and DEX Listing are scheduled for Q1 2023—meaning user and investor funds will be exposed to unaudited contracts.
Entirely anonymous team and missing legal entity jurisdiction; vague claims of 'veterans and industry-leading managers' without verifiable identities, LinkedIn profiles, or past track records.

3% transaction tax (2% liquidity, 1% reflections) creates prohibitive economic friction for a freelancing payment token and lacks any disclosed vesting schedules for presale, marketing, or team reserves.

Absence of core platform architecture: no escrow smart contract design, no arbitration or dispute resolution mechanisms, and unsubstantiated claims regarding debit card issuance and payment subsidies.

all_findings.description: Unregistered securities offering and passive profit promises from token taxes.
all_findings.evidence_quote: As a result, the holder is not required to stake their token in order to generate good income, all they need to do is hold and earn.

all_findings.description: Token launch, presale, and exchange trading precede security audit.
all_findings.evidence_quote: Q1 2023: Delancer Pre-Sale, Bep 20 Token Launch, Dex Listing ... Q2 2023: Contracts Audit

all_findings.description: Anonymous team with unverified marketing claims.
all_findings.evidence_quote: The talented crew behind Delancer is comprised of veterans and industry-leading managers, engineers, and marketers with extensive experience in diverse WEB 2.0 platforms.

all_findings.description: Reflection tokenomics impose a 3% tax on every transaction, penalizing legitimate freelance commerce.
all_findings.evidence_quote: There will be a 3% fee on every transaction that will divide in this format: 2% Liquidity, 1% distributed among the holders

all_findings.description: No vesting or lockup schedules disclosed for presale (15%), marketing (10%), or CEX reserves (20%).
all_findings.evidence_quote: Total supply 200 Million: Burn 30M, Pre-sale 30M, Airdrop 5M, Marketing 20M, Rewards 15M, Dex Liquidity 60M, Reserved funds for Cex 40M

all_findings.description: No governance model, timelock, or multisig disclosed for managing liquidity or admin controls.
all_findings.evidence_quote: Reserved funds for Cex 40M ... Dex Liquidity 60M

all_findings.description: Unbacked payment subsidy claim with no designated funding pool.
all_findings.evidence_quote: Employers who seek to pay their employees in DFL will receive a subsidy in comparison to other modes of payment.

all_findings.description: Global debit card and cash withdrawal claims without banking partnership, BaaS licenses, or KYC/AML disclosures.
all_findings.evidence_quote: Provision of a card to an independent contractor to make payments and cash withdrawals from any location in the world.

all_findings.description: Complete lack of technical architecture or code references for escrow or dispute resolution.
all_findings.evidence_quote: To address this issue, we will leverage smart contacts between the buyer (employer) and the vendor (employee).

all_findings.description: Superficial cryptographic assertions with no protocol design.

all_findings.description: Deflationary claim contradicts static reflection model without an ongoing burn.
